Game Overview

In Prison Escape Plan, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your inner mastermind in Prison Escape Plan, where strategic thinking trumps speed. Carefully map escape routes past vigilant guards, navigating evolving patrols. Each level tests your ability to outsmart and adapt quickly, capturing the suspense and thrill of a perfectly executed prison break.
